verdict.summary: The change correctly relocates eleven cross-crate ratchet values into a zero-dependency, unpublished leaf crate and updates both each enforcing test runner and the central scoreboard to consume the same constants. The dev-dependency edges preserve shipping graphs while making changes to the floor crate propagate through the CI reverse-dependency cone. The remaining textual checks are crate-local, coverage is partitioned across exactly one of three guard mechanisms, and the new pin/non-vacuity tests preserve the intended ratchet invariants. Documentation and the residual audit are consistent with the implementation. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect in the diff. Targeted Rust tests could not be rerun in this environment because cargo is unavailable.
